newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam's leaders to stand down.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam's leaders to stand down.

text.p: Vietnam's official media announced on Monday an official list of candidates for National Assembly elections due next month.
The list did not include the names of President Le Duc Anh, 76, Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet, 74, or Communist Party General Secretary Do Muoi, 80, indicating that a leadership change was imminent.
Under Vietnam's constitution the prime minister and president would have to stand for election in order to have their terms in office extended when the new National Assembly convenes later this year.
Muoi's exclusion from the list does not automatically mean that he will step down, however the absence of a National Assembly seat indicates that his term is unlikely to continue for long.

Monday's list did not include nominations from all provinces in Vietnam. However, political analysts said the absence of the names of Anh, Kiet and Muoi from a list of central organisation candidates indicated their clear intentions to resign.
Although the names of several likely successors have been mooted, there are no indications yet that a final decision has been made on who will replace Vietnam's ruling troika.
